params.body:
Subscribers now read the full report in the same full-screen reading room as the preview (#160), instead of only the PDF download.

## How
- **`/reports/{slug}`:** for whoever the report is deliverable to (Decode, Intelligence), the reader gets every page, `/reports/{slug}/page/{n}` for 1 to `page_count`. Everyone else still gets the preview.
- **`/reports/{slug}/page/{n}`:** behind `auth`, and 404 unless `isDeliverableTo` the user, the same rule as the download.
  - A guessed page number beyond the report is 404 too.
  - It serves a JPEG with `Cache-Control: private`.
- **`App\Reports\PageRenderer`:** renders one page with Ghostscript (already on the server, no PHP extension needed) the first time someone opens it, and keeps it under `storage/app/private/report-pages/{slug}/{pdf mtime}/`. A new PDF therefore re-renders by itself. Locally a page takes about 250 ms the first time.
- **The PDF never reaches the browser.** Only page images do, one at a time.

## In the reader
- It fetches the next page while you read, so turning a page does not wait on a render.
- **On the page:** for a subscriber the button reads "Read the report" and the line "The full report, 25 pages, full screen". For everyone else it reads "Preview, 4 pages of 25".
- **The last page** for a subscriber reads "End of the report. Keep it for the deck", with the PDF download.

## Tests
`FullReportReaderTest`, with a stand-in renderer:
- a subscriber sees every page link and gets a page;
- a guest is sent to sign in;
- a Signal user gets 404;
- the page after the last one is 404.

343 passing. Checked locally with the real 25-page PDF of "Going to School in Phone-Free Europe" and a local Decode test account.
params.title: Subscribers read the full report in the reading room
